description: AR Foundation enables you to create multi-platform augmented reality (AR) apps with Unity. To learn more about AR Foundation, click the Documentation link above.

samples.description: Runtime debug visualizers for AR Foundation trackables. Includes a prefab for Markers that displays real-time data properties. Assign it to the 'Prefab' slot on your Trackable Manager to visualize trackable behavior and assist with runtime debugging.
